name: Saturday Morning Astrophysics at Purdue (SMAP)
org: Department of Physics and Astronomy, Purdue University
what_you_do: A live Zoom session each month. Purdue physics and space experts explain space science. Students try fun tests and activities at home.
deadline_text: Next session: October 17, 2026. Sessions are the third Saturday of each month, subject to change for holidays and special events.
how_to_apply: Use the Grade 8-12 Students Sign up for SMAP button on the page (a form). You are then notified about upcoming sessions.
